author: Doctor
text:
Good analysis and nice clean charts. Your entry was nice and there may
 even be another shot at it. Price action does not show a whole lot of
interest yet. On the 4hr I wouldnt want to have seen price action where
you entered or most of the sweet entry would have been eaten away. A
place to look for hesitation is around 92.75, it is old ignored supply
and will either get taken out or price will bounce. I would favor a
bounce, false bullish move and continued down side for a nice long run
to under 81.

Well done.

Hello everyone!

Unfortunately trading from Sydney means I sleep when most of the action
goes down and generally find myself awake a lot longer than I should be

My EU trade came back to BE which I triggered manually and was only a
few pips from my target and I wasn't awake to see that Pin. Anyway, will
 just look for another opportunity!

Following is a quick scalp I took on AU. It was only a scalp because
there has been a clear bullish movement this week and I didn't want to
push my luck. H4 flip zone got me looking for a short, and I took it on a
 M5 supply. TP taken manually at 2:1 as price seemed to be flagging
down.
